cohort: 665,423 Danish women with an abdominal operation between 1977 and 2013
finding: The risk of adhesive bowel obstruction increased after each abdominal surgery, was highest after colorectal surgery, lowest after gynecological surgery and cesarean section, and was lower after laparoscopy compared to laparotomy.
mod_finding: The risk of adhesive bowel obstruction was lowest after cesarean section compared to other gastrointestinal procedures.
